paragraphs: Rav Yaakov, son of Rav Acha bar Yaakov.

The story in [Kiddushin 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.29b.11) tells how his father sent him to study with Abaye. When Yaakov returned, his father saw that his studies lacked sharpness and told him, “I am better than you. You stay at home and I will go to study,” and so on.[^1]

notes.text: [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2091&lang=en) cites the same passage and summarizes it by saying that father and son both studied with Abaye.
